shared_elements: horizontal band composed of repeated short vertical/pendant strokes
isolated animal figure placed above the banded element
curving hook-like or serpentine linear motifs
justification: Both surfaces show a broad horizontal band made of many repeated short strokes with a small profile quadruped placed above it, which is the closest correspondence, but this is a generic configuration that could arise independently. Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A shows modelled relief birds with prominent beaks, a snake-like form and an anthropomorph in distinct stacked registers, while B shows a flat silhouetted vessel with upturned terminals and scattered linear marks.
